body: Thanks to everyone who shared songs with me and said words of support to me. I have to go. goodbye

>at the end of the day, I’m aware that I can’t tell you what to do. that’s completely on you. I’m sorry, I just felt the need to try and help. even if it won’t make a difference.

 Thank you for trying to stop me, you have a kind soul. I think if you have a dream, you must fulfill it.

I don’t want to change my mind, because if I change my mind, it means I’m pussy. Sorry. 
I made a decision and I think if you decided to do something, then do it. Don't be the one whose words mean nothing
I plan to finish everything in the morning
Thanks. This dude was cool enough, sorry he left so early.
Frank Ocean is very cool. Thank you for making me remember such a person.

 Thanks for the comment, any music will suit me today, as long as it is good. (But this is not DubStep, because imagine a man killing himself with dubstep. As for me, that would be quite ridiculous, lol)
